:::{#cor-uncorrelated-cor-zero}
#### Uncorrelated means zero correlation

If $X$ and $Y$ have finite, positive [variances](#def-variance),
then $X$ and $Y$ are [uncorrelated](#def-uncorrelated)
if and only if $\Cor{X,Y} = 0$.

:::

::: proof

By @def-correlation, $\Cor{X,Y} = \Cov{X,Y} / \paren{\SD{X}\,\SD{Y}}$,
and $\SD{X}\,\SD{Y} > 0$ because both variances are positive,
so $\Cor{X,Y} = 0$ if and only if $\Cov{X,Y} = 0$,
which is @def-uncorrelated.

:::
